analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering compatibility problems between [product_name] Soft [version_no] and Windows Vista, especially regarding mismatched drivers and library files. These issues prevent the software from detecting the COM port, resulting in a loss of communication with the device. The main frustration centers around identifying and installing the correct driver and DLL version for their operating system.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy driver installation process, automatic configuration regardless of system architecture, and instant recognition of the COM port within the software.
